title: Riddle Time
summary: Look for words with double meanings.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: I have hands, but I cannot clap. I have a face, but I cannot smile. What am I?
points: I have hands, but I cannot clap. I have a face, but I cannot smile. What am I?

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: A riddle describes an object in a funny way.
Think of ordinary things that have parts with the same names as body parts.
points: A riddle describes an object in a funny way.

steps.title: The method: List and match
sentences: Hands, face, and no clapping or smiling.
Which common thing has hands and a face?
It sits on a wall or on your wrist and tells something.
points: Hands, face, and no clapping or smiling.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: Its hands point to the time and its face shows the numbers.
Riddles use words that have two meanings.

quiz.q: I have keys but no locks and a space but no room. What am I?
quiz.why: A keyboard has keys and a space bar.
